title: COD Rejection Spike in Riyadh
description: COD rejections in Riyadh have climbed well above the network average over the last 30 days, driven mostly by high-value orders where customers change their mind before the courier arrives.
recommendation: Consider requiring phone verification for COD orders above SAR 300 in Riyadh, or offer a 5% prepaid discount.

title: Inventory Mismatch on 5 Products
description: 5 SKUs currently show different stock counts across Noon, Amazon, and Shopify compared to the physical warehouse count, creating overselling and lost-sale risk.
metric: 5 SKUs showing different stock across channels
recommendation: Sync inventory immediately — 2 products are at overselling risk on Shopify.

title: Abu Dhabi Conversion Rate is 2x Dubai
description: Traffic converts to paid orders at a notably higher rate in Abu Dhabi than in Dubai, suggesting an underexploited pocket of demand.
recommendation: Increase ad spend in Abu Dhabi by 30% — higher ROI potential.

title: Tabby BNPL Orders Have 45% Higher AOV
description: Orders paid via Tabby's buy-now-pay-later option carry a significantly larger basket size than the store average.
recommendation: Promote the Tabby payment option more prominently on product pages.

title: Electronics Return Rate at 18%
description: The Electronics category returns at more than double the store-wide average, primarily due to sizing/compatibility confusion and unmet expectations.
recommendation: Add size comparison charts and video reviews for electronics products.

title: Friday-Saturday Sales Drop 35%
description: Revenue consistently dips over the Gulf weekend (Friday-Saturday) compared to weekday performance, indicating a scheduling gap in promotions.
metric: Weekend revenue SAR 8,200/day vs SAR 12,600/day weekdays
recommendation: Launch a 'Weekend Special' promotion targeting Friday 2-6 PM.

title: Fetchr Delivery Failure Rate at 14%
description: Fetchr's failed-delivery rate is running well above other courier partners, disproportionately affecting Riyadh routes.
recommendation: Review the Fetchr SLA — consider shifting Riyadh orders to SMSA.

title: Beauty Category Growing 28% MoM
description: The Beauty & Personal Care category is compounding month-over-month, outpacing every other category in growth rate.
recommendation: Expand the beauty product range — high demand, low return rate (3%).

title: 3 Products Below Reorder Level
description: Three fast-moving SKUs are projected to stock out within days at the current sales velocity.
metric: Wireless Earbuds, Phone Cases, USB Cables — 5 days of stock left
recommendation: Place a reorder immediately — these products account for 15% of revenue.

title: Noon Outperforming Amazon in Fashion
description: Fashion & Apparel products are converting noticeably better on Noon than on Amazon.ae, with wider selection producing outsized returns.
metric: Noon fashion revenue SAR 67,000 vs Amazon SAR 31,000
recommendation: List 5 more fashion products on Noon — higher demand and better margins.

title: Peak Ordering Hours: 9-11 PM
description: Nearly a third of all daily orders land in a two-hour window in the evening, well after typical business-hours marketing pushes.
metric: 32% of daily orders placed between 9-11 PM GST
recommendation: Schedule marketing emails and push notifications for 8:30 PM.

title: Shipping Cost Eating 12% of Revenue
description: Shipping spend has crept up to a significant share of monthly revenue, driven by current per-shipment courier rates.
metric: SAR 41,108 spent on shipping this month
recommendation: Negotiate a volume discount with Aramex — current volume qualifies for a 15% reduction.

title: Arabic Product Listings Convert 23% Better
description: Listings with a complete Arabic description meaningfully outconvert English-only listings across all three channels.
metric: Products with Arabic descriptions: 3.8% conversion vs 3.1% English-only
recommendation: Use the AI Content Generator to create Arabic descriptions for the remaining 34 products.

title: Duplicate Orders Detected
description: Several orders this week share the same customer, items, and a sub-hour time window — a strong signal of accidental duplicate checkouts.
metric: 7 potential duplicate orders this week (same customer, same items, within 1 hour)
recommendation: Enable duplicate order detection — estimated SAR 4,200 in prevented losses.

title: Customer Retention: 22% Repeat Buyers
description: About one in five customers returns to place a second order within two months of their first purchase.
metric: 1 in 5 customers orders again within 60 days
recommendation: Launch a loyalty program targeting repeat buyers — they spend 40% more per order.
